text: First time here and we had a tabletop of 18. Very authentic and the service was incredible despite our big group. our server kept a smile and was attentive to our needs every time. The food tastes  just like our homemade food & would definitely recommend coming here to eat as we will most definitely come back to eat here again. We were able to meet with the owner and chefs and they were amazing. With only two chefs behind the kitchen, it was all phenomenal! This place hit the spot!
Love the food and the cute little patio. Went for happy hour with friends for their BoGo Tacos. Did not disappoint!!

Finally got to try Bevi! The first time I tried I went around 3:30 on a Sunday and apparently they close at 4pm which is strange so they didn't have anything left basically. I tried another day and I ordered crawfish, shrimp, and a daiquiri. The crawfish was really good, seasoned well! The shrimp was ICE COLD! That was really disappointing. I was eating there so I didn't expect that they would give us the shrimp right off the ice. The daiquiri was like satsuma flavored I believe and it was very tasty but I didn't feel any kind of buzz for $10. So, I would definitely recommend the crawfish. The shrimp not so much.

Service was ok, food was mediocre at best. Place overall wasn't very clean. My table was super sticky, the menu had food stuck to it and I had to ask for new silverware bc my fork also had old food stuck to it. Bathroom was awful. The place is kinda dreary and reminded me of the beginning of every creepy "Hills Have Eyes" type horror movie. Like, the group goes to the slightly nasty local breakfast dive and something feels off the whole time, setting the whole tone for the movie. HA.

Romios is one of our favorite restaurants in Boise. They even deliver! They have both Greek and Italian dishes and everything has been good. Our go to dishes are the pasticio, calzone, boat of cheese, and gyro which comes with homemade chips. Their chicken lemon rice soup is the bomb.

Ate here a few weeks ago and only one employee was wearing a mask and he worked in the kitchen. Additionally, the manager even came up to our table with no mask. 

Decided to give it another try since the mask mandate came out and again employees were not wearing masks. A few that did have masks had them pulled below their chin.

The description also says they wear gloves, which also definitely was not happening.
Love there pizza and the bolognese sauce with ravioli was great. We liked everything we have had.
A local highlight near the Loop. Their pizzas are so juicy, with great sauce and great deep crust. They even make for good leftovers. As a bonus, they even have bottles of Fitz's on hand.

I really like Pollo Tropical.  It still somewhat amazes me that I can order sweet plantains via a drive through.  You can get healthy options and when the chicken is cooked well it's really delicious.  With that being said I think I'm done visiting this particular location. The service hasn't been good here and my last visit was the worst.  I had to wait several minutes for a cashier to appear and when he finally did he had no idea how to redeem a reward from the app, which meant more of a wait while he went and looked for help.  When my food was ready they gave it to me for dine-in instead of to-go.  The woman who was handing out the food couldn't understand me when I pointed out the error. When she finally realized what I was indicating she started insistently pointing at the order screen.  No matter what it said I'm still going to want it to go!  I'm going to stick with other locations for my plantain fix.

I think the four star rating here is dangerously inflated. I wouldn't even say this place is "good but not great. " Really, it is just OK.

We found our selves here after a Yelp search piqued our interest by showing the oyster happy hour.  One dollar per gulf coast oyster? Sold! The rating further suggested a quality experience. 

The weather was quite crummy but the awning was set to protect against the rain.  We started off outside but the restaurant decided upon further review they wanted to seat everyone inside. First strike in that the restaurant was over crowded with no spacing between tables. 

Our wait staff was attentive and kind. For drinks I asked for a strawberry margarita. We ordered the cheddar biscuits, crab cakes, parmesan crushed oysters, and some raw oysters. Couldn't wait for food!! As it turns out this is when all of the disappointment really set in.

My drink tasted awful. It seemed like it was prepared fresh without mixer but it was poorly balanced and very sugary.  There was an odd after taste. I tried to politely tell our waitress that the drink was made incorrectly and asked for it to be remade. After an awkward pause she obliged and as I later found out, charged me for a second drink despite the bar tenders error. The first drink literally only had one or two sips missing, signaling the lack of satisfaction with it.

The cheddar biscuits were an attempt to elevate those that are made at Red Lobster. As it turns out, the oyster bar has nothing on the

Ah the old collegiate favorite! Boston can eat a free birds burrito in 3 bites. I prefer a bbq Casadilla. The new free birds you see around the world are a spin off of this but they are more like chipotle. This is the oj. Tacos are also ‍.

I was visiting Metairie, LA and looking for a place to eat. I know that Louisiana is famous for cajun foods especially boiling crawfish. I was craving for some BBQ ribs so I went to Dickies Barbeque restaurant for dinner. The restaurant is kind of small, but the decoration was very beautiful and super clean. The service was beyond my expectation. Their BBQ ribs and pork sandwich were so delicious. Their BBQ was reminder me of Jackstack BBQ in Overland park, KS. I was very impressed that this restaurant have very good BBQ. I will definitely come back here again next time I visit New Orleans area. I would highly recommend everyone come here to try out their BBQ. You won't be disappointed it.

Honestly, this place has awesome pizza and the calzone bites are legit to die for. I live close by so I get it often and I've never had a bad experience. The service is good, the delivery is always quick and they have great food. I would def recommend this place.

Much appreciated after the storm.  I've stopped for coffee and sweets before. This time, I stopped by for breakfast.  Eggs over easy, bacon, and hash browns like home cooking!  The Coffee au lait was perfect.  Friendly and patient service.

This is our favorite breakfast spot. They are so clean and festive with their service. Food is fantastic all the time. The duck bacon is our favorite. Today is super bowl day and all employees were dressed like pirates. Outstanding restaurant everyone should give it a try.
I love this place, yummy food by the beach and the best mimosas! Came here for my 21st bday brunch and loved it. This place is so cute and had really good service

I just picked up food from here now. I've been trying to pick up food from here for the passed two days but I've came in 12 minutes before closing and I get shunned out by the same girl both times. I get that it's before closing but I also work in food and if we are not closed WE WILL SERVE YOU UNTIL WE CLOSE. THEN, today I was calling to put in an order for pick up and I asked the girl "do you guys have the ahi poke right now" and she tells me "I don't know probably not" and I didn't wanna ask if she could ask because now I feel like a bother. So I went in when I went to pick up my food and asked again... and they had it. I'm just mad about the horrible service here. They have the worst customer service. I won't be returning to this location the staff is terrible and being welcoming. The girl couldn't even ask if they were serving poke. It takes 2 seconds for her to ask and she acted like it was such a burden. This was a waste of money. They're so strict about closing 5 minutes before closing and locking their doors but when I call to put in the order you can't even ask if you have a specific item. Hence why I like to go in and ask in person because they don't care over the phone.
All of us loved our meals!  Highly recommend.  We sat outside which was best for us because it seemed like it might have been noisy inside.  The grouper sandwich was awesome.   Staff was nice.

I live right around the corner from this Chipotle, and Idk why I keep coming back. The past 4 times I've been they are out of lettuce, or corn, or anything crucial to a bowl or burrito. My fiancé stopped in this afternoon, they were out of chicken and beef. Like what?!?! A joke.
It's all good! Everything that I've ordered has been a hit. Go grab a drink, order a sandwich. You won't be disappointed with what you get.

Went to watch the blues game here and it was a fun place to go and watch!! Great happy hour deals and good food. It does get very loud when there is a sporting event going on so keep that in mind. Also for them being packed the service was still good. Very happy will be going back!
This place is awesome. Been a few times and have loved every experience. Took my nephew while he was in from OKC and he loved the beer selection.
Can't go wrong with Qdoba, great burritos and the delivery was free : ) The delivery was pretty quick.

I've been wanting to visit for more than 2 years. Procrastination and Covid got in the way, and when things began opening back up 2Fish had to stay closed a bit longer. This allowed me to try their other restaurants first, The Little Hen. That actually was fortuitous since the hen had to change from fine dining to a market/ sandwich shop concept( more on that in a separate review) 

This is a very focused menu, 10 choices or less but all sounding delicious. I selected octopus as an app and the tuna as my main, my co-diner went with the scallops app and barramundi main. French bread with a chimichuri sauce was supplied while we waited. The octopus was perfectly cooked and all elements of the dish went with each other. The Rhode Island scallops were pristine and also close to being an entree size portion. I didn't get much of a taste of the barramundi but can say that the fish was seared to perfection and tasted great. Co-diner heartily agreed. My tuna( something I rarely order out) was amazing. The moniker " sushi grade" is overused and misleading. But in this instance spot on. The fish was coated with a mole  spice and seared masterfully, the inside was still raw and melted in my mouth. The components on the dish added to the main ingredient, buttery rice, plump and tasty black beans, spicy salsa verde and a sweet raisin sauce to balance everything. 

Not wanting the meal to end we both ordered dessert, a fig panna cotta for her, and the chocolate tarte for myself. The tarte

The food itself and the staff were top notch.  The reason for the 3 stars was all due to the Manager on duty this past Sunday.  This man was extremely unprofessional! The staff were working their butts off at a very busy time and this jackass was yelling and berating them in front of a store full of customers.  At one point, while I was at the register paying for my food, with a line behind me, he yelled at the poor kid taking care of me to come sweep something up! I felt so bad for these young people, probably at their first job ever and having to deal with this rude ass, "I'm in charge so deal with it guy!"

This is a great donut shop worthy of your business!
Fresh and delicious doughnuts, a good variety of choices. 
Come and try them out!

This place is amazing. You basically have to get a Bloody Mary because they are unlike any other - bacon vodka and jalapeño vodka, complete with cheese, olives, bacon, celery, and tots on top! We also really enjoyed the pulled pork nachos. The portion is huge and it is so delicious. Huge onion rings too! We will definitely be returning. I would highly suggest this place to anyone!

The attention to detail at this property blew me away. The landscaping, the lighting, the flower arrangements, the interior design and furnishings are gorgeous. We walked the entire property and were so impressed with everything. 
We had dinner at Malibu farm restaurant and the food was incredible. Again, we were so impressed with how delicious everything was. The staff was so friendly and attentive, our waiter Sean gave us great recommendations, we couldn't have been happier with our meal. 
We only stayed one night on our way to Big Sur but can't wait to come back so we can spend more time on this beautiful property.
Love this place, but please keep the "Not Dogs" on the menu! Enthusiastic servers, energetic atmosphere, and great food.

The Couch Tomato did not disappoint. If you are looking for GF pizza... run don't walk here. My boyfriend and I sat outside and were greeted promptly by the friendly workers. We got the gluten free pizza and the salmon salad. Both were delicious!!

Great place to celebrate birthday! 
Food tasted authentic and it's a huge serving. They have a lot of authentic dishes to choose from but I went with the safer option of Gyro sandwich 
The inside looks incredible, they have pictures on the wall that makes you think that you're in Santorini. 
The service was not that great when we went but I think it was just our server, other tables had great service.

Wanted to check out this business and were cutting it close to closing time.  They were more than welcoming and immediately offered fresh margaritas anything they could past closing time.  The food was delicious, and the service was amazing.  They earned a return customer and will recommend.  Just what the area needed!!!
Love love love dim sum garden! Always a go-to for lunch and dinner, in a group or solo!!

BEST Hawaiian food in all of central Florida/ anywhere in Florida. The coconut rice has huge chunks of real coconut in it, pork is super tender, and the Mac salad is anything but under dressed. First time finding good Hawaiian food since leaving San Diego and will definitely be coming back. Portion sizes are the bang for the buck as well.

On our way from Philadelphia to Va we found this true diner gem. We had homemade soup (beef barley and a bowl of chicken noodle). It was definitely homemade and delicious. My husband had a tuna melt sandwich which he really liked served with fries. I had a garden salad with tuna fish and feta cheese and oil and vinegar on the side. It was a lot of food for the money. The whole bill came to $20... Inexpensive and yummy. The place is definitely not fancy... A real diner. Our waiter was wonderful too. So courteous and trying f to please. . So if you like  diner menus and the simple diner kind of atmosphere you'll be happy with this family owned and operated find.

Social distancing friendly-popular take out location also.

My first visit here was almost two months ago. My wife & I were looking for a place to meet another couple outside where social distancing was easy. Angelos has a little patio where this is easily doable & it never seems packed (Murfreesboro pike traffic probably has something to do with that as it's loud with people racing down the street).

I tried the picnic pizza the first time I was there and they were out of sundried tomatoes but it was still very good. I will say the huge crowns of broccoli on the pizza probably would put most people off but I thought it was different & a very good pizza in terms of dough, sauce, & quality of ingredients. 

Another patron was taking a to go order & stopped by the fence & told us about the double stuffed pizza they have there and that we have to get it next time. That's exactly what we did this second time. Again we had the entire patio to ourselves for about 2 hours on a Friday evening. The pizza was hands down one of the best I've had around town. For reference two of my favorite pizza places in Nashville are Bella Napoli & Two Boots pizza. The XL was large enough for 4 adults to share and have slices left over. It's a huge pizza. It's basically a supreme pizza on the bottom with a pepperoni on top. A lot of cheese & a ton of flavor. 

I also highly recommend the regular calzone as it's damn good by itself with some marina on the side.


Staff is very nice considering the add

Can't say enough great things about this place. We made a reservation for brunch and we were blown away by the entire experience. The interiors is beautiful. We all ordered the bottomless mimosas, and our glasses were never empty...they were hardly ever half empty! Very attentive staff and they had live music. I ordered the Benedict's. Outstanding. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting New Orleans for a great brunch!

This pizza lives up to the hype.  The dough is crusty and chewy with a great flavor (expect it to be a bit charred).  The tomato sauce tastes fresh and the cheese to sauce ratio is perfect.  The online ordering is really easy, but fair warning that there could be a long wait time.  We ordered on a Sunday evening and had to wait over 2 hours for our pizza to be ready.  Make sure you follow the directions to pick up on Lee Street (small alley).

I love Azian, and have been coming for years! I recommend it to everyone as my go to place but after tonight I don't think I'll be coming back for a while. I went with some friends and we both placed our order at the same time. A short while later their food comes out and my food has yet to arrive about 30 minuets pass and Our waiter asks how everything is going and I mention that I'm still waiting for my order and she replies "right" and walks off. Another 10 minuets pass and our waiter is nowhere in sight so I ask another waiter if they can check on my order another 10 minuets pass and they come back and mention that it was given to someone else so they're finishing it up now. My friends are done eating at this point and I had noticed that our waiter has delivered at least 3 different orders to the table across from us but has made no attempt to let me know what's going on or let alone check on us. We asked another waiter if we could get refills and she replied with "who's your waiter cause I'm busy". Another 10-15 minuets pass and I STILL have not received my food. One waiter lets me know that the owner is giving me a discount for the inconvenience, cool. I also asked if I can speak to a manager because it's been over an hour and I still haven't got my food. I was notified that there was no manager. I asked a different waiter if there was a manager working and they said yes, I asked to speak with them and they said "I can talk to him for you". At this point I'm already ove

Was looking for a place to eat with friends that was indoors so we could beat the NOLA heat. Don't let the outer appearance of the restaurant deter you away. Nice neighborhood bar feel inside. Limited seating inside but they do a good job accommodating everyone while following COVID regulations. Our sever was super nice and gave good and honest  recommendations which is always a plus when trying a new restaurant. I called twice prior to making my way over to the  restaurant and they were very prompt when answering the phone. If you are meat lover than this place is perfect. If you are vegan or vegetarian the menu is limiting. Everything was good. The fries were a bit salty so my recommendation would be to order unsalted fries and add your own seasoning.

Talula's was a superb experience. The decor and ambience were lovely. The service, impeccable. The food, delicious and perfectly executed. We waited a bit for our table and sat at the bar, where a friendly, knowledgeable bartender made my partner two cocktails, and made me a "mocktail" when I declined a drink. That was really nice of him! Many restaurants do not offer the little "gifts" and amuse bouches we received. That was an impressive touch. Even the manager came to introduce themself and check on how we were doing. I don't think my boyfriend was able to take a bite without savoring it, pausing, and saying some variation of "this is so good." His meal, the "pork and apples" was the best thing he's ever eaten. I enjoyed the ravioli. My favorite part though was the cucumber with feta. It was exactly what I wanted it to be, and more. We left Talula's absolutely stuffed, happy,  and satisfied. Our only regret is not saving room for dessert. We will definitely be back! 
Thank you Talula's Garden for an amazing experience! I'm going to tell everyone I know who visits Philadelphia that they absolutely must dine at this fine establishment.
Great food, great ice custard, super clean and friendly staff. My son loves this place. Highly recommended!
Food and drinks were very disappointing.  From being over salted to not knowing how to make drinks.  Too bad the restaurant looks nice.  I wouldn't go back the next time I'm in Indy.

After a Reno Aces game and we were given coupons at the game for Jack-In-the-Box, buy one large drink and get a free Jumbo Jack. We both were hungry and decided to stop at the Jack-In-The-Box at Los Altos and the Pyramid Highway. I'll have to admit, my wife and I are not fast food eaters primarily because of the processed foods most sell are full of calories and more salt than I consume in one day. But we decided to give it a try, what the heck, we seldom do this, so let's go for it. We ordered a Jumbo Jack and the large drinks and we also order a small and a large order of French fried potatoes. My wife's order came out first and she noticed how limp her French Fries were and she asked if she could have a fresh order and they politely replied, "yes".  When my order was ready, I did not have any French fries so I ordered mine separately. My wife got her order of fries, but I did not get mine. I brought it to the attention of the young cashier and she said it would be a few minutes more. I was 2 bites from finishing my burger when I got my large order of fries. There should be no question about the 2 stars. There are other fast food places that run efficiently and the staff members are very polite. The staff at the restaurant was nonchalant and there was even an off-duty employee helping at the counter. I worked in the restaurant business but I choose not to be critical about service and the ways things should be operated. Not for me to say, mostly because I don't know what th

Yummy yummy yummy. That's all I can say. Everything tasted so fresh. I loved how the ingredients are all local. We had the caeser salad which was perfect and refreshing. We ordered their famous pepperoni pizza which has a drizzle of honey on top. This was something totally different but the sweet and spicy was a great combination. We also had the chanterelle pizza. I didn't think I would like this bc it had truffle oil on it but I was wrong. It was another perfect pick. I highly recommend Bettina's
Food and service has gone terribly bad.  Used to go there on Friday nights.  No quality any more.  Shame.  John must not be interested.

SUMMARY: FINALLY, A MODERN CHINESE BAKERY IN TAMPA!

My wife was "over the moon" the minute we stepped into Sweet Buns Bakery. The cafe was bright and well furnished, with seating for roughly 30 people. The left hand side had shelves and tall clear displays with many types of Chinese pastries. The pastries ranged in prices, but most were $2-$3 each. It was hard to choose only two buns to eat, so we ultimately ended up with three. 

We ordered two pastries that were filled with whipped cream; one was adorned with fruit while the other had Oreo pieces. The third bun, which was my wife's favorite one, was the coconut bun with taro filling. All three buns tasted delicious, freshly baked, and made with care. In fact, as we were informed by the staff, all of their pastries are made on-site.

The cafe also had lunch options available, which included noodle bowls and rice entrees. I'll update this review once we try these options.

For a quick bite to eat or a dessert after a meal, Sweet Buns Bakery is definitely worth a try.

P.S.: It's located on the eastern side of the Winn Dixie plaza on Fowler.
If I could give this place a zero I would. Not only was it super expensive but the muffuletta was not impressive annnd they gave me KRAFT MAC N CHEESE!!! Y'all wrong for this.
Chicken wings are the best in town!! I eat here regularly and customer service is always really good.  Highly Recommended!

Great classic steakhouse. All your favorites, from the cozy bar to the salad bar to the tableside flaming desserts. This is a place you'll return to again and again. Like we do.

A couple of things I want to emphasize - first of all, the food is cooked perfectly, just as you ordered it - from rare, to well, well, well done. And secondly, they'll do it just the way you want. Substitute, ask for special stuff, no problem.

TIP: The bar seating area is tiny, so if you're going to hang out before dinner, you might do that somewhere else. If you're going to eat at the bar, of course, dive in!

I've been a fan of Zydeco's since the first time I ate there 10+ years ago.  The food here is absolutely authentic Cajun.  I've had jambalaya and gumbo in Louisiana that wasn't nearly as good as what I found in Mooresville, Indiana.  However, my absolute favorite dish on the menu is the Black Cat - two blackened catfish fillets served on a bed of jambalaya.  It's got a ton of flavor and is a great representation of Cajun cuisine.  The entrees come with a soup or salad option - get the garlic soup.  For appetizers, if they have the boudin balls available,  don't miss them.  They aren't on the every day menu, but they are so tasty.  If that's not your thing, get the potato salad nanoose - you won't be disappointed.  And dessert,  you can't go wrong.  Pecan pie, Death by Chocolate cake, and bread pudding - all of them are excellent.  And of course, the drinks at the bar are top notch.  I had the Rougarou and my wife had the Hurricane and we were both very happy with the drink choices.  Service was slower than normal, but it was a busy Friday night and we weren't in any hurry.  Highly recommend making the drive to check this place out.

Based on delivery only.
Really like a 4.3 but I rounded up to boost their overall rating. 

Greek Salad: best ever!!!! Omg I'm addicted. It's literally perfect.

Tomato Soup: was ok. A bit oily.

Eggplant & warm hummus platter: very good and different! Runny egg yolk - yummmm. 

Chicken Shwarma: good but I was slightly disappointed (not as good as my fave place in LA- perhaps unfair to compare). But don't get me wrong it was very good. 

Pita: someone said in their review it's store bought - I'd like them to tell me what store I can buy pita like this at! Lol. It was very good! 

Beet salad: super yummy (yellow beets !) 

Tomato & cuke side that comes w platter - blah!! But it is April, so neither tomato nor cuke season.

Tip: all those dishes ordered and only 1 pita so be sure to select or ask for extra pita. 

I will def be ordering again, was a bit pricey for all those things but still very yummy.
Fantastic. After roaming around St Pete with all the "plant based" restaurant. Was thrilled to find a great burger !!!

Very popular restaurant, especially on a Friday. They are offering dine in as well as takeout. For takeout you can order at the restaurant and then get it to go or you can order over the phone and pick it up at the bar. They have a veggie burger available to substitute on the burgers, it is a vegetarian black bean patty. They also have a veggie wrap that you can make vegan by omitting the mozzarella cheese. Lots of options for kids meals. When you enter there is a long bar on the left-hand side and table seating on the right hand side of the restaurant. The restaurant itself is not very large so it gets full fast. When order take out, the side salad did not come with dressing and the fries did not come with ketchup so make sure to request those items before leaving. Service is fast and friendly. Prices are reasonable.

I went to Fogo with a party of four and sat at the bar. We ordered the beef empanadas, shrimp cocktail, chicken sliders, polenta fries, and a burger. Hayden, our bartender that wasn't really a bartender, made our super fruit lemonade. Now, Hayden was slow BUT he made a good drink and he was very courteous. The shrimp cocktail was good but more importantly they were HUGE. The chicken sliders were a little dry to me but being able to add condiments helped. Lastly, the empanadas had a good flavor and I was told the burger was good and filling as well.
Food is good, but the order is always incorrect. Example... If you say no onions, you get a ton of onions etc.
I ordered the Chicken Mediterranean bowl. It was delicious. The chicken was beautifully grilled, moist and well-seasoned. All of the toppings and sauces were fresh and flavorful.

I know with eating at any McDonald's, you have to have a certain set of expectations. But this location is awful. They always take forever for any simple order, are constantly rude & could not be bothered by any little task, and will put you off just to go take a smoke break. No joke, I rolled up to the drive thru & they said it would be 10 mins before they could take my order because they were taking a smoke break. Really? Horribly managed & I hope they see this so they know their lack of customer service hasn't gone unnoticed.

Great food, grouper cooked perfectly, fried chicken fresh and crisp, salads are fresh and enormous, shrimp cooked to perfection!  
A bit crowded and noisy , but well worth it!

This was my first time trying Fired Pie and it was really good. I really enjoyed choosing from all of the different toppings they offer. It's fantastic that they offer vegan cheese and this was actually my first time trying a pizza with vegan cheese (it was very good btw lol). I also chose to add artichokes, olives, red onions, and mushrooms to my pizza. It was done fairly quickly and the person who was working during the time I came in was very friendly and quick on his feet. Give this place a try if you're near one of the many Fired Pie locations in Arizona!

Great tasty BBQ with a touch of indie flair. Awesome buns. Thinly sliced steak fries are a good example of their creativity for something we've eaten millions of. Nice Outdoor seating. Smooth 'branded' Mule. Not a chain. Great bourbon selection AND PRICES. Blanton's pour for $8.50, a double for 16. Covid19 safe practices inside except for 'grab your own silver wear'.

Really great atmosphere and the staff was great as well. 

We had a preset menu

A side salad, salmon and non flour chocolate cake. 

The salad had an amazing balsamic dressing that was very flavorful. 

The salmon was seasoned to perfection and vet tender and the broccoli was perfect. 

Wine list was great with some local wines that went very well with the food.

(6/7/19)
Probably one of the worst service I've experienced in a long time.

We (table of 4) received our food....the 2 filet mignon entree (one cooked med-rare and other med-well) given by the food runner, gave it to the wrong person.  He just gave the food and left without making sure it was given to the correct person.
We also ordered a side spaghetti ($6) to eat with our meal...but they forgot to give it to us with the rest of our meal, it took forever to find our server to remind her that she forgot to serve our side spaghetti, and when we reminded her, she didn't apologize, and when we finally got our side, again she didn't apologize, and by time we received it, we finished our meal and it was undercooked.

It was even for my bday and I didn't even ask about the free ice cream because of the horrible service.

Will we come back? No way!

I'm ok with prices going up but why do you have to change your pizza, I always come here for lunch when I'm craving pizza but I guess I will have to find somewhere else. You are making the pizza so thin I can see trough it.

Because it was such lovely weather we walked through the park and found ourselves at Bird's nest cafe. 
First off, kudos to the staff. The lady who took our order was very helpful. We ordered a grilled cheese sandwich and she advised us that it might be a little too plain! She was right and I am grateful that she took the minute to warn us to temper our expectations! 
We also ordered the recommended lunch sandwich of the day, a tomato, pesto, mozzarella sandwich! Oh Yummm~! 
Both came with a bag of chips. You could choose which chip you wanted. Awesome! 
And they had Oatmilk latte, and whole milk for my partner. So we ordered one of each! 
On the whole, great location, great food, great service and a great cafe, despite us being the only ones there! 
These are truly hard times, y'all~!

It one of good seafood place in Dunedin. This restaurant is about 4.5 stars. The reason they stay at 4 stars due to service during lunch time. They have one waiter and reception for the afternoon. I can see 6 table of customers but not enough waitress. Obviously this is a balancing act for the restaurant if they need to spend more overhead. 

With that said. The food are excellent. 5 stars. We started with fried crab crawl. This is special of the day. $12 for about 20 crawls. The crawl is fresh with great coating. Love it. 

Our main dish is oyster poboy and the blackened hogfish. They give a lot of oyster at the poboy. The oyster are great. My friend was not able to finish and take home. The hogfish blackened is ok. Not like the Cajun style. But the fish meat is good and tasty. It is good sandwich. 

Overall experience is good. Hope they continue the good food.

Olio Crudo Bar has very delectable dishes and a mellow come as you are vibe. The patient bartender offered the daily selections and suggested wine pairings with the meal. The Costatine d'Agnello with fingerling potatoes in ginger olive oil sauce was a feast for the tastebuds. The sauce commingled well with the lamb juices and rosemary. The lamb medallions were a good size and cooked perfectly, medium rare, plump and juicy. The tiramisu finished the meal. I liked this simple go to sweet pick me.
Great homemade food, offers vegetarian menu as well. The owner is very friendly. Restaurant itself needs a facelift and as good cleaning. I order take out.

Great food. The portions are large, the service was outstanding. We have passed this place up several times before due to the large amount of people we see waiting outside fora table. I'm glad that we were able to get our timing down so we were able to try it.
Good but food is overpriced. They need more options and different wines. Pretty limited.

I am so tired of the performance of the staff that works here. Maybe if they had adequate management it would make a difference but from the moment you walk in the door it's an unpleasant experience. I wish I could give zero stars

They use the cheese wiz that's for broccoli...
The fries might be good but ares were way over fried no potato left in just crunchy
Cheesestake just was not good

La Spada is a terrific place for pizza and appetizers.  I think it is the best pizza in the Indianapolis area and the service was quick and friendly. I would highly recommend it to anyone that wants great food.

We come here all the time. As a local who appreciates this place I thought I'd leave a review. The service is usually efficient and I appreciate how clean it as, as well as the relaxed ambience. Here's what I recommend from the menu: Fresh Rolls (get peanut sauce instead of the dressing they come with), Pad Thai of course, the Pad See Yew is delicious, the Curry Fried Rice is excellent, and their curries including the Massamun curry and Yellow Curry. My husband's favorite is the Drunken Noodles. I also always have to get their Thai Iced Tea of course! I think for the amount of food you get the price is very reasonable. We always have leftovers for lunch the next day!

The service was super fast and food was awesome! Delivery guy was sweet and polite! I would order again. $20 for huge sandwich, fries, fried mozzarella cheese sticks and chocolate mousse! Enough for two!!!!! Meatball sub was awesome.

Love this place amd the owner the best subs around hands-down amd You get what you pay for the biggest subs around full of me love this place crazy about this place and out from down south Miami this place here in Holiday is killing everybody the best 1000

I am so glad that they open! The Dark Side burger with Chuck Sauce, spicy and sweet, is fantastic! Not a fan of burgers but this was one I will definitely come back for. The Chicken Delmonico was tender chucks of blackened chicken that also was delish! The bartender/ owner was fabulous! Stop in!!!

Talk about Chinese food this place is thee best. Dining in or takeout they treat you well and the food tastes so fresh. The restaurant is clean, the chef is so awesome and amazing this place is a must visit.

We drove from Indianapolis for the weekend and found this jewel online and it is worth the drive just to eat here. We were here for a quick one night getaway and came for dinner on Saturday night. We loved it so much we came back on Sunday for lunch!  The Tripleta and Jibarito sandwiches were excellent. The Pernil Bowl (Puerto Rican-style slow roasted pork with arroz con gandules and tostones) was seasoned to perfection.  The rice with pigeon peas was so good it rivaled my mom's, who in my humble opinion makes the best home made Puerto Rican food (I may be a little biased about the latter, though.  Ha ha).  We also tried their red sangria and their recipe was spot on, complete with chunks of fresh fruit as it is meant to be.  To my Puerto Rican compatriotas, you definitely need to give this place a try. Great location, too, caddy corner from a beautiful park called Lafayette Park, perfect for walking with a happy tummy afterwards. And the owner, Mandy is super friendly and charming.  Service was great, too.  Mayo Ketchup will definitely become a must stop for us every time we come to  St. Louis!

I am so happy that they are back open for dine in! All the safety protocols are in place and the food is amazing! If you want some amazing kebabs this is the place! It's a nice small family owned restaurant with great food!
We have come here for years and the last two times we have come we had to return our meals and they could have cared less if we were upset - so sad it's time to find a different breakfast place

Rudest customer service!!! I ordered food to go and they told me that it would take 40 mins and they ll send me a text when ready. I come in 1h later and food isn't ready. When I complained about how long it took, the rudest person working there ( man in his 40s) told me that I can just get a refund and told me to "fuck off!"
Telling someone who are paying you 80 bucks worth of food to fuck off isn't the smartest way to do business..
Also the workers aren't the friendliest.horrible place. I know that I ll be warning all my friends to not come back here ever again. ( specially not on a Friday or Saturday ) hire more people if needed but don't give fake time frames.

Ordered a margarita pizza for delivery after it was recommended by a coworker. The pizza came warm and perfectly made. Not to much sauce and cheese but the perfect amount! Will definitely try some of the other menu options soon!

I cannot say enough good things about our experience here last night. We decided to come in for dinner with all three kids after a day of exploring. We called ahead and made a reservation and were seated promptly. We opted to sit inside as it was a pretty hot day, although the courtyard for outdoor seating is beautiful. 

Started with the crab Napoleon and hush puppy appetizer. Both were amazing. My husband LOVED the crab while the kids devoured the hush puppies. Both were served with a tasty remoulade sauce. Yum. 

For entrees my husband had the taste of New Orleans dish. He said his favorite was definitely the red beans and rice. So if you're not wanting to try it all maybe go for that. The girls and I were craving red meat. I was a little nervous as I couldn't find any reviews on the steaks here. But we took a leap and ordered them anyways. I am SO glad we did. I had the filet with asparagus and potatoes and the girls split the 14oz New York strip. When I say these steaks were some of the best we've had, I mean it. They were perfectly seasoned and cooked. Ugh. I'm getting hungry thinking about it again. 

For dessert we had the bananas foster bread pudding. I don't eat sweets but my husband and kids said it was delicious. 

Overall highly recommend this place. Especially the steaks. Say hello to the manager, Solomon. He's such a nice guy. You won't regret stopping in here!

We were in New Orleans for our son-in-laws' 30th Birthday on of all nights New Year's Eve!!!  The staff here is amazing!  We ordered chicken on line for the party and when I arrived for order pickup, it had not gone through.  There were easily 30 people in Line.  Albertine was so helpful in getting everything sorted out and out the order in quickly!  Her efforts on what was so obviously a crazy busy evening save our party (we would not have had food without her). Her efforts made a huge difference in a tough situation and we will always go to this Popeye's when in town!!

Egg rolls were the worst I ever had. 

Pho was meh. 

Service was great. Vick was phenomenal.

I love this place. The live music is fantastic and refreshingly eclectic, the pizza is delicious (to date, my favorite is Cinco de Queso), the drink selection is awesome, and the crowd is super fun. We go here frequently on Wednesday when the Joe Park trio is playing and the pizza is half price.
Was looking forward to a hoagie and no one was wearing a mask!  Goodbye Jersey Mikes.  You need to take this seriously and train your employees. The one girl was coughing over the rolls!

The lunch deals at Cafe Zen are a huge part of why I love coming here. They're very affordable and delicious! You also have the option of adding a sushi or roll combo to your lunch sets. When I'm not getting their lunch, I love coming for the nigiri sushi and sashimi. Their raw fish is so fresh an delicious. My personal favorites for their nigiri is their scallop(hotate) and sweet shrimp(amaebi)! When I'm getting rolls, I love to get a side of their special hana sauce which is sweet, tangy, and so yummy!

You couldn't ask for more. Great service, food, and beer list. Probably good wine list also. All this in a beautiful outdoor setting with live music on Friday and Saturday night. Plenty of space indoor also. This will be our go to place when we want a good beer and live music.
The Ravenous Roofer

#ThankYouThursday

Thank you Wood Bakery for providing our area with the highest quality baked goods! I love your cakes, donuts, cookies, and pies! Your baked goods are always a hit at a party and are celebrated by my daughter in the morning as she enjoys her donuts. Thank you!

First of all i was ignored by at. Least 4 people before a young lady in the back came out to assist me. The problem for me came as I was the second person that should of been waited on but I was the last. I haven't been on South County in a while and really forgot the racial overtones that exists in those areas. It saddens me. I never said a word to anyone just took pictures and made a point to observe everyone and what they were doing. I wanted to give them a chance not to be this way but unfortunately it is the case. On top of that the gooey butter cake doesn't hold a candle to the Gooey Butter at Companion so much better in taste and texture. Imma a fat girl and relish carbs especially baked goods and after two bites it sits on my desk. Im sure I'll toss it because it's just not good. So no reason to go back to this store. Customer service is horrible and so is the Gooey Butter.

My veal dolce vita was very good and the accommodated my no starch request.  We ordered an item without onions after specifically asking if onions could be removed.  Unfortunately it arrived with onions.  The issue was corrected at no charge.  Much appreciated as my daughter wouldn't eat. 

The staff wasn't as attentive asI would have expected. There was no ask for fresh grated Parmesan cheese or fresh ground pepper.

This place is really good.  I got the big Tommy.  Which is hot roast beef on garlic cheese bread, with grilled sweet  peppers and onions. The sandwhich was amazing. The sauce from the roast beef soaked into the bun to make it a perfect consistency.
I paired this with their bbq kettle chips which stee amazing themselves and drank a nice dr. Pepper with the awesome crushed ice. Only downside was it was raining couldn't sit outside and not a ton of seating,  definitely worth it.

Beers are just too pricey. $8-9 for a 10oz with a $1 tip just isn't worth it. The beers are sub par. However, they allow dogs, that's cool. The owner seems cool. It's just really hard to spend $30 bux for 3 beers and no dinner.

My polish sausage was smoky and tasty without sauce. However, the smoky sweet thick sauce I added didn't detract. 
The greens I dreamed about from a previous visit lacked the seasoning I remembered. But, these are still some of the best greens I've gotten from a BBQ spot. 
During the COVID era city-mandated face coverings are enforced. It's a bit harder to social distance in this small space, but patrons try. Curb pick-up service available.

The bartender was AMAZING!! She was super attentive and gave great recommendations. However the food was HORRIBLE!!! This was of course not her fault. Food was greasy and tasteless. It actually made my husband and I sick within a few hours. Don't waste your money
My fiancé comes here every Sunday, they no his order when he says his name.  Food is good quality and customer service is good.  Highly recommend this place.
Unbelievable!! Quick and delicious tacos and wonderful service. Will definitely be back!!!

It's tradition to go here for my birthday and although COVID put my birthday plans in jeopardy we were able to go! Unfortunately the tone of the restaurant has changed completely. 

The people:
We arrived yesterday (a Tuesday) at 7:20pm. When we walked in, we were not greeted by the 5 employees standing at the hostess stand, but asked rather curtly by one of the people, "can we help you?" and the question was asked almost as if we didn't belong there. My friend was already seated so we called her and found her. She expressed when she arrived with flowers and cake no one at the hostess stand offered to help bring the items in, it was as if she were bothering them. The only positive aspect was our server Michaela who was super attentive and kind.

At the end of the night at 9:50p a man who I believe is a manager comes up to the table, interrupts our conversation abruptly and says "we close the doors at 10" and walks away. 

I have dined numerous times since the reopening of restaurants and have never received this type of treatment and especially to receive it from a double eagle steakhouse is absurd. 

Please dine at a restaurant that actually appreciates its guests.

Ate here tonight with one of my best friends. We were quickly sat outside on the patio. Wonderful view, yummy cocktail and great service! We had MC (Mary Catherine) and she was fantastic. Very attentive, knowledgeable, and sweet as can be! Definitely ask for her next time you're here!

The hype is real. We ordered the sausage sampler board to start and it did not disappoint. Juicy on the inside yet still had that nice crust on the outside. So much flavor! The duck was absolute perfection. Perfectly cooked and delicious. We had the Brussels and Mac n cheese on the side. Wonderful meal! Rounded out with beautiful cocktails as well. Friendly and professional and service with a trendy ambiance. Highly recommend.
Best and most authentic Italian restaurant in the Tri-State area. From innovated dishes to classics, nothing compares.
Best bagel shop around! Everything on the menu is delicious and the owners are incredibly nice. Delivery is always quick as well!
COVID made the lines on a Friday night invisible so this was a quick in and out. Best Philly steak I've had.
Always great food and great service. We've never had a bad experience here. Fun atmosphere! Kid friendly and always super sweet to my son. The only Mexican place we eat out at.

My hunny decided to go crazy and had a ton of food delivered to my apartment. It was fantastic bcuz I got to taste a little of everything. The Rigatoni D is as good as everyone says. I'd say by far my favorite of all the dishes. The cheese ravioli was a bit heavy, but I liked it nonetheless. Probably wouldn't order it as a main dish tho. The shrimp pasta was good. LOTS of shrimp. Cesar salad was great. The salmon was over cooked. The butter cake was phenomenal. The chocolate cake too. I really enjoyed it all. They didn't deliver my Pellegrino, but that's fine. After all he went through with them canceling the original order, I'm just glad I eventually got to eat.

We stopped by Freddy's drive thru for lunch on our way to pick up things from my wife's office since she'll be working from home for a few weeks. 

These steakburgers are legit! The shoe string fries were delicious. The service and the speed of delivery were fantastic!

I started my career as a Steak 'n Shake manager.  With Freddy's in the same market I can see why SnS is having issues. 

I'm looking forward to trying more of their menu especially the frisco burger!
The staff at this location is unbelievably disrespectful. Avoid this location. The food reflects the staff's attitude (poor).

I thought they did a great job with the distancing thing. The food was delicious.  The drinks were strong but not burnt. The waitress was a little stressed out with how busy it was for an afternoon stop. Will be back.

Overall I liked my experience the food was good. Although the portions are kinda small. They have an huge menu and it was kind of overwhelming but the guy at the counter helped me. I ended up getting the French quarter bowl and a fan&fruity smoothie . Both were delicious and I would definitely go back. I loved the shrimp and avocado in the bowl

We've been trying to go here for so long, but kept forgetting...probably because its off the beaten path on Weber Rd about a block or 2 west of River Des Peres.  I immediately loved the place.  As we opened the door, there were steps going down to the restaurant.  It immediately reminded me of the old Rossino's in the city.  It wasn't decorated like Rossino's but it had low ceilings and was no frills.  

It was fairly crowded with a big group of people.  It was fairly loud because of the sound bouncing off the plaster ceiling and concrete walls.  This is a great place for a large group.  

We weren't able to get their home made TR's because they were out, but we had a 14 inch home made Italian sausage/Mushroom Pizza.  It's apparently a cheese mix, so it's not all provel like most St. Louis Style.  I'm not even sure if there was provel on it, but it was a delicious pizza.  

We saw a lot of people doing carry out as well.  I definitely recommend this place!  We will be back...especially to try the TRs!
Went in for a coffee. The place was packed. Coffee was ok. Service was good. Just a regular coffee shop with ok coffee.

Firebirds is a solid place! Very clean place. They are definitely going above and beyond to take all covid precautions by sanitizing, social distancing tables as well as using face mask. Down to business my waiter was very nice and on top of her game! The string beans were really good topped with spice pecans made a nice touch!! The prime rib was cooked perfectly and very flavorful as it should be. The horseradish sauce it came with was amazing shockingly probably better than a lot of high end steakhouses I've been to. This is not my 1st visit here and every time it's been solid with no complaints. Even if you order something that might not be there best the waiter warns you lol. I don't think anyone would be disappointed coming here for a casual meal or a date. Very clean nice put together establishment.

There are some great folks working here.  Kudos to all of you.  Ate here twice during my four-day Tampa visit.  Each time we were a group of about 10 people.  First:  some of the finest octopus I have ever eaten.  If you like octopus it is a must-have for sure.  Super tender and the sauce, oh the sauce!

Other dishes that were a 10:  the squid ink pasta with shrimp (had it both times), the pizza and the short rib (one of the table favorites).  

Another HUGE plus is the price of the wines.  I'm a wine lover and the prices were fantastic, as was the depth of the wine list.  

Lastly, we showed up at 6:30 pm on a Saturday night without a reservation (I know, who does that?!?!) and the staff miraculously were able find us a place to sit.  Also, the manager came by our table each night to check on us to ensure our satisfaction.  NICELY DONE!!   A great place that I just could not recommend more.  THANK YOU!

Excellent restaurant!  The patio and interior are equally beautiful.  We ordered a couple Apps (charcuterie board and soups) then split an omelette. Food was great, owner was very personable and shared that the recipes were from her family.   Definitely would come back and happy we stumbled upon Vyoone's while walking the neighborhood.!

Thank you to Vanessa and to the lady who also assisted us on Sunday for the Seahawks game!  Also a shout out to the Philly's manager guy who helped us on Friday evening with amazing cocktails & the reservation!  We had a great time & the food and service was wonderful

I was looking for an authentic Cuban sandwich and found this great place on yelp.  I ordered "The Best Cuban" with red beans and rice.  This was the BEST Cuban sandwich that I've ever had...perfect taste and all the right ratios.  My son had "Tres Tacos" and had a hard time deciding which taco he liked best.  The waiter was polite, friendly, and very helpful.  My favorite places are local small-business restaurants and you can tell Barracuda's takes pride in the the food they prepare.  It is rare that I give 5 stars on yelp, but they truly deserve it.

First and last time.  Food is mediocre at best.  We like to support local but this place left us so thirsty!  Every dish had a brown looking sauce, maybe soy?  Same with wonton soup, which is weird.  Ordered sweet and sour chicken, wonton soup, general tao chicken, and steamed dumplings in a spicy sauce!  All brown!  We also asked for brown rice, they said they didn't have brown rice.  I don't get it, but in any event we will not be back.

Family owned and certainly served with care and love. It's like walking into your healthy neighbor's kitchen and them sharing a meal with you. 
Great portions, balanced nutrients. I'm vegan and he's not but we both loved it and look forward to return to the area to have again
Crazy slow. Only customers inside and it took 20 mins to get a small order. Place is clean enough and service was just barely good enough.

Eat here several times a year when I'm in town. Food is always good and service usually is also. Went in for a late snack, apps..... we had one server, not very friendly, then handed over(no introduction) to another server, also not very friendly. Another server brought our food, all plates just set in front of wrong diners, no "did you have...?" Managers everywhere, servers everywhere but we had to ask for drink refills, to see a dessert menu, no offer of coffee with dessert. And it wasn't busy at all! As we left, the hostess watched us silently, no, thank you, have a nice day, nothing. Disappointed.

One awesome place to visit in Fountain Square, especially in the summer. I think the waiter we had, his name was Max if I'm not mistaken. Best server we've met thus far. It was my husband and I and Max (the hiker....him and his girlfriend love to hike). He made it an awesome night by treating us to a famous English Drink (forgot the name, but they'll know when you ask) and Fish and chips, with a wedge salad it was better than Amazing! My hubby had the Big Ben Burger. He ate every last bit of this humongous burger, to say the least, it was beyond amazing as well!! Definitely stop by and give this British tavern a try, I'm sure you will revisit again!!!

First time here as I noticed it across the way from my buddy's gym, evolve fitness. I walked in and got a card and checked out the menu online. Very nice site and looked enticing so I was eager to go in for lunch the same day to see if the food tastes as good as it sounded. I was pleasantly surprised and satisfied with my experience. Everything looked and tasted fresh from the first bite and sip! From the Viet iced coffees, summer rolls to the soup. And the price is excellent! for the quantity and quality of food. Less $$ than other places that are lower quality or just as good. This is a huge plus for me. Ordered some banh mi's to go so I have high hopes for them later. Only draw back was the spotty service. It was really quiet in there and I was hardly checked on. Had to call on service a few times to get my lunch going and wrapped up to leave. Overall, i highly recommend this place and I will def be going back for more. I pray they keep the standard of food up and up there service game.
Everything was great but this was the taco we got with our meal? Compliments to the chef....

Delicious, adorable, and far exceeded my expectations!

Great decor! New drink (called Purple Haze) was AMAZING (so refreshing and perfectly sweet). I got the Eggs Florentine and it was very tasty. Our waitress was very attentive and welcoming, which was a great treat on this dreary/icey/freezing Monday Feb. 15 morning. 

Highly recommend!

Came here pre covid with my friends and loved it. The service wasn't the best but char grilled oysters made up for it. These grilled oysters were SO SO good. It's smothered with this amazinggggg sauce that you can soak up with the bread. The regular oysters were mediocre compared to these!
Delicious Mexican food fabulous frozen margaritas well worth the visit food is always fresh never disappoints with outside seating chips salsa guacamole it's all so delicious

This was cool little spot, actually spacious inside. The customer service was really great. Friendly staff and very attentive. Me and my friend sat at the bar. We went for Happy hour and they had great options with a lot for a happy hour to choose from. My favorite was the truffle fries! Omg the sauce was to die for! Lol

Isot is one of my favorite restaurants in the South Street area. This Turkish gem is friendly, attractive, and delivers excellent food.  Its $12 lunch special is one of the best deals in all of Philadelphia.  A recent meal in mid-afternoon (to avoid any crowds during the pandemic) proved Isot is still at the top of its game.  The lentil soup was delicious and the accompanying salad fresh.  The Kasap kofte were full of flavor but not as flavorful as the tasty Adana Kebab.  A serving of Abugannusch and Haydari completed the feast.

Our server Amy was always friendly and efficient .... and I can't wait for another meal at Isot!

Well I know we're in a Pandemic with Coronavirus and all. However I can't believe that Ruby Tuesday's is serving up leftover garbage. 
They sent me a coupon buy on get one free, ok I took them up on their offer. We ordered 1/2 stack ribs with fries and onion rings , my husband a bacon cheeseburger with fries and a side order of hot wings. We glance looks good we thought. 
Got this bag of garbage home, the rib bones are black smothered in BBQ sauce, the chicken barely done, and since when did they start making hot wings using a bottle of hot sauce? The fries were also leftover. We spent 30.00 bucks. FOR A BAG OF LEFTOVER GARBAGE. I know they're trying to make a living and all but to give your customers left overs is not good business. Ribs with black bones and hard are OLD. 
They should of trashed them or ate them, themselves. We waited outside after paying with cash for a receipt she never came back and we tipped her 5 bucks for a bag of garbage, 
I had no recourse without a receipt or using my credit card so I'm UP THE CREEK without a paddle. But at least I can warn someone else Don't  buy from here,  the food is leftovers that should of been thrown away a week ago.
This place is unbelievable.  They have everything.  Whether you actually buy anything or not, it's worth spending some time here.

We had lunch here. The food was good and tasty. Encountered two different staff members during our trip. One was friendly and helpful and the other was well..... not very attentive and not personable.  
I will give it another try but my initial impression was  the food was worth the visit but the experience was lacking.

I really like this place. Southern comfort perfectly describes what I feel when I eat here. The only knock I have is the wait time use to really struggle about a year or two  ago but it seems like they really got things together. Love the bread and the adobo pulled pork!

Ambiance: This place is a hole in the wall. After eating at Biryani City it will soon become your new go to Indian restaurant. Once inside it is feels nice and busy, but subtle and quiet. Not too loud. There were two separate rooms. There seemed to be a bit of a distinct color difference between the two rooms. But none the less we were there for the food!

Food!: We ordered cheese dosa, butter naan accompanied with chicken tikka masala. The cheese dosa was large but light. It was accompanied by three flavorful sauces. The butter naan was soft and with a slight chew. It went well with the tikka masala. The masala had a great depth of flavor that made you go back bite after bite. 

Service: We arrived at the table with water already on the table. The server arrived shortly after to take our order. He had a slight difficulty understanding what we were ordering and ended up repeating our order twice. They brought our food out rather fast considering how many people were in the restaurant. 

Notes: They charge less money if you pay in cash rather than card.

I just have to say that this was my first and last visit to Bar B Cutie.  I requested pick up time at 1:30pm.  We got there at about 1:40pm knowing that orders for restaurants are always late no matter what.  When we arrived, we sat at the box waiting to say that we were here for about 4 minutes, when they finally came back to ask how they could help us, we told them what we were there for and was told to pull to the window.  When we got to the window we sat there again, not informed on what was going on.  The girl finally said that it would be a few moments as they were making the gallon of tea that we requested.  At this point it was already 1:50pm (20 minutes PAST when we wanted to pick up the order)  and then finally 10 minutes later we finally got our food and tea.  The large ice tea we requested was nothing but ice (we could barely get the straw in the cup).  We asked for extra bbq sauce before leaving and the girl asked which one, not knowing anything about your place asked what they had and she said sweet or original.  I said both.  She then handed my husband 2 very small containers that weren't even half full.  I just said forget and left.  We left at 2:03pm and went straight home which was 10 minutes away.  Got home and unpacked the meals and NONE of the meals had ANY  BBQ sauce on them.  The roast beef did have the gravy.  But the other meals had NOTHING.  They were ice cold and EXTREMELY DRY!  I asked for EXTRA HOT SAUCE on one order, but got NOTHING.  My friend t
Great pizza! Good service. Would definitely recommend.
Best desserts in the docks!  We go here a lot and love trying new things every time!  A must try for anyone local or visiting.
Really great food. Maybe worst delivery service in the city. Never have gotten anything remotely warm.

I don't ever write reviews but this was aweful pizza. I drove all the way to Tampa today looking for good pizza and went w this place based on the positive reviews, but ended up being quickly aggravated. Looks are deceiving when I got my pizza it looked great, but upon closer exam I quickly realized it was nothing more than a ring of crust with a soup interior. I should of got a spoon w my pizza to scoop it up. No consistency what so ever, I don't even think it was cooked. The whole pizza collapses once you pick it up. I could of got a better pie from dominos, which is the worst pizza in my opinion. Very disappointed don't even think I'll get pizza in Tampa again. This was absolutely insulting to any pizza place. They get 2 stars only bc the staff was very accommodating and friendly. Based on the pizza though epic failure!
Great place for a snack or a full blown lunch, serves beer! Great tacos to choose from, I say try anything once!
Ate brunch here. Great food and drinks. Service was top notch. Would recommend going here. Was very packed but worth the wait.

This place was so awesome.  I walked in and saw the design of the space.  It was a very nice place.  We sat at the bar and Alex and Nick were incredible.  They are good for a joke and amazing with drinks.   I ordered the d fashion and both of them made it for me at different times.  Both were amazing.  Then they took our order and the food that comes out of that kitchen, incredible.  This place is awesome for the atmosphere, the drinks and the food.  A place like this could revitalize downtown Clearwater.

Every once in a while I get a serious craving for for Peruvian food and unless I'm home (LA area) I'm usually out of luck. Such a craving hit as we were driving through the Arizona desert so with fingers crossed to Yelp I went. Luckily Inca's Peruvian came right up and had pretty epic reviews. The restaurant is located in a strip mall containing a large grocery store, so parking is ample. They have four tables outside and 6 inside so get there early if you want to secure a spot. The decor was super cute, traditional doilies on the tables, the menu straightforward not too busy. We ordered a saltado (chicken, tomatoes, onions, cilantro, soy sauce and other spices served with rice) for my husband his favorite. We shared the shrimp causa (mashed potato cakes with aji amarillo and shrimp salad) and I had the ceviche mixto. OMG! It was so good! Some of the best I've ever had. La Mar in Lima would be proud. The fish was so fresh and the prawns were so big, the citrus so clean. I've already declared that we will have to stop and get at least the ceviche every time we find ourselves in the Tucson area. Bravo
Love this place. I order at least twice a week. Great food, great taste. I love getting combo A . All my favorites in one for a great price.

I was craving Pho while being in quarantine and Pho & More hit the spot. The Pho was delicious and I love that when do takeout the beef is raw so you can cook it at home. That way the meat is not over cooked and still very tender. All the ingredients tasted very fresh and the broth was tasty and flavorful. I will definitely order from there again.

Great service and even better food. Portions are huge for such a low price! They always have a variety of specials and always so clean. They take reservations and I am definitely bringing my family back. Cant wait to try something different because everything looks so good!!! Such a cute place im in love!
Stupendous food, excellent service. Wish I could afford to come here more often. Steak was cooked to perfection, and baked potato was huge. I highly recommend this restaurant.
